metric_definitions.benchmark_return: BTC completed5m price return; excludes fees/funding and is not an executable benchmark account
metric_definitions.net_return: ending marked equity /initial -1, including accrued funding and reserved exit costs
metric_definitions.sharpe: mean UTC daily NAV return /sample standard deviation *sqrt365; risk-free0
metric_definitions.max_drawdown: maximum1-NAV/running NAV peak; sampled5m closes, not intrabar worst case
metric_definitions.recovery_days: longest calendar duration below a previous sampled equity high, includes unrecovered tail
metric_definitions.profit_factor: sum positive COMPLETE lifecycle PnL /absolute sum negative COMPLETE lifecycle PnL
metric_definitions.win_rate: positive COMPLETE lifecycle PnL /complete lifecycle count; open trades excluded
metric_definitions.payoff_ratio: mean complete winner /absolute mean complete loser
metric_definitions.expectancy: mean net PnL per COMPLETE lifecycle, USDT
metric_definitions.turnover: sum absolute filled notional /mean sampled equity over the period
metric_definitions.beta: sample daily covariance(strategy,BTC buy-hold)/sample BTC return variance
metric_definitions.alpha_annual: 365*(mean strategy daily return-beta*mean benchmark daily return); descriptive regression intercept
metric_definitions.tracking_error: sample daily standard deviation of strategy-minus-benchmark *sqrt365
metric_definitions.var95_daily: negative5th percentile UTC daily return, floored0; historical
metric_definitions.cvar95_daily: negative mean daily returns at/below5th percentile, floored0; historical
metric_definitions.rank_ic: mean same-clock Spearman correlation of factor/prediction and forward labels across six assets
metric_definitions.ic: mean same-clock Pearson correlation across available assets, minimum4 and nonconstant inputs
metric_definitions.ic_ir: mean clock-level IC /sample std; not annualized and not proof of independent samples
metric_definitions.direction_accuracy: fraction sign(prediction)==sign(forward label); excludes zero actual labels
metric_definitions.auc: rank-U area under ROC using continuous prediction and binary positive-return label; ties averaged
metric_definitions.mse: mean squared raw forward return error; includes baseline-zero comparison
metric_definitions.mae: mean absolute raw forward return error

news_coverage.scope: FOMC official statement news; not general crypto news or analyst consensus
news_coverage.cpi_source_status: BLS archive HTTP403 observed; no CPI or consensus surprise is fabricated
news_coverage.lexicon: Fixed transparent phrase counts, not a trained sentiment model

limitations: Previously available history; time-isolated representative diagnostics, not independent untouched out-of-sample proof
Fixed contemporary six-name pool has selection/survivorship bias
Official FOMC statement news only; no broad crypto-news or consensus-surprise coverage; BLS403 retained
Original official release time plus5min controls availability; current fetch hashes do not prove historical ingestion latency or absence of later edits
Factor count includes correlated horizons and interactions, not74 independent alpha sources
Short representative windows cannot establish annualized return persistence; CAGR/Sharpe/alpha are descriptive extrapolations
5m close plus adverse slippage and1percent observed turnover is a capacity model, not order-book or native matching certification
Historical contract precision/minimums and exact funding settlement-price evidence remain incomplete
Inspecting holdout factors or configuring portfolios against them consumes holdout for future selection
